detail.longDescription: I've received an OpenAPI YAML file from which I need to generate a Rust REST server. It starts that way: openapi: 3.0.3 info: title: Service Request Catalog Management description: | This is the Service Request Catalog Management OpenAPI specification version: 5.0.0 paths: /serviceCatalog: get: tags: - serviceCatalog summary: List or find ServiceCatalog objects description: This operation list or find ServiceCatalog entities operationId: listServiceCatalog parameters: - in: query name: filter description: Filter query parameter to define a query filter for retrieving only resources which fulfil the filter query based on attribute names, operators and valid attribute values schema: type: object additionalProperties: type: string style: form explode: true - in: query name: defaultFilter description: A process specific default filter is always implicitly set or added to the custom filter. If no custom filter is set and the parameter is set to 'false', no default filter will be set schema: type: boolean default: true - in: query name: allProviders description: Only the records for the 'main' provider will be returned by default. the records for all providers will returned, if the parameter is set to 'true' schema: type: boolean default: false responses: 200: description: OK content: application/json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/ServiceCatalog_RetrieveResponseArray' examples: exampleServiceCatalogRetrieveResponseArray: $ref: '#/components/examples/exampleServiceCatalogRetrieveResponseArray' 400: $ref: '#/components/responses/http400' 404: $ref: '#/components/responses/http404' 500: $ref: '#/components/responses/http500' I've attempted to generate it through the openapi-to-rust tool, but it is refused with the error message: cannot generate Axum query extraction for 'listServiceCandidate' parameter 'filter': styled object parameters with additionalProperties have an ambiguous wire namespace I don't understand this message clearly. Looking at the YAML part: schema: type: object additionalProperties: type: string I guess the one who wrote this spec is telling: "any property you want, provided it has a string type" . But where could it be a namespace problem, here? I can't reject the YAML file I've received: it's one coming from TM Forum family of OpenAPIs, is a standard, and it generates with other languages, such as Java. So I'd like to find the change that would help openapi-to-rest generator to pass the obstacle.
